connector.name: Advanced Zebrunner MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Advanced analytics, reporting, and safe mutations for Zebrunner. 64 tools, 14 resources, 17 prompts.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-zebrunner. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the maksimsarychau account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: ZEBRUNNER_URL
env.description: Base URL for your Zebrunner instance (e.g., https://your-instance.zebrunner.com)

env.name: ZEBRUNNER_LOGIN
env.description: Your Zebrunner username/login

env.name: ZEBRUNNER_TOKEN
env.description: Your Zebrunner API authentication token (Personal API Token from Settings → API Tokens, or refreshToken from SSO session)

env.name: TIMEOUT
env.description: API request timeout in milliseconds (default: 30000)

env.name: RETRY_ATTEMPTS
env.description: Number of retry attempts for failed API requests (default: 3)

env.name: RETRY_DELAY
env.description: Delay between retry attempts in milliseconds (default: 1000)

env.name: MAX_PAGE_SIZE
env.description: Maximum page size for paginated API requests (default: 100, max: 1000)

env.name: DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE
env.description: Default page size for paginated API requests (default: 10)

env.name: DEBUG
env.description: Enable debug logging (default: false)

env.name: ENABLE_RULES_ENGINE
env.description: Enable the rules engine for test case validation (default: auto-detected from mcp-zebrunner-rules.md file)

env.name: STRICT_URL_VALIDATION
env.description: Enable strict URL validation for security (default: true)

env.name: SKIP_URL_VALIDATION_ON_ERROR
env.description: Skip URL validation if it fails (less secure, more permissive) (default: false)

env.name: ENABLE_RATE_LIMITING
env.description: Enable rate limiting for API calls (default: true)

env.name: MAX_REQUESTS_PER_SECOND
env.description: Maximum API requests per second (default: 5, max: 100)

env.name: RATE_LIMITING_BURST
env.description: Allow burst of API requests (default: 10, max: 200)

env.name: PORT
env.description: HTTP server port (required for StreamableHTTP mode)

env.name: ZEBRUNNER_URL
env.description: Base URL for your Zebrunner instance (e.g., https://your-instance.zebrunner.com)

env.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
env.description: Transport mode: stdio, http, or auto (default: auto)

env.name: MCP_AUTH_MODE
env.description: Authentication mode: headers, oauth, or both (default: headers)

env.name: MCP_SERVER_URL
env.description: Public URL of this MCP server (for OAuth metadata)
